content:
With contributions by @Bingyu Xia and @Wang Jingting, we are near a fully sorry free version of Cohen structure theorem modulo some rearrangement of proof.
Modulo ind flat equal to flat that is currently in another repository by @Christian Merten, the Cohen structure theorem itself is sorry free now.
However, due to the need of representing complete local ring as quotient of regular local ring, this still needs some results from #36507 to prove that finite variable MVPowerseries over regular local ring is again regular.

Congratulations on getting this massive theorem over the finish line! I'm just glad my earlier work could be a small piece of the puzzle. I will keep working on #36507 and make necessary adjustments once I get feedbacks, hopefully we can have the complete picture soon!

Would any one mind me proving finite variable MvPowerseries over Noetherian ring is Noetherian via adic completion of MvPolynomial? Or we should follow the way from Powerseries? It seems MvPowerseries is really needing #36507 to further develope.
I think we should just work on #36507. It gives this basically for free and it is worth to have it anyway
OK, but the defs and lemmas are similarly oriented as MvPolynomial so I doesn't have much idea on reviewing :(
@Bingyu Xia do you think it is possible to split #36507?

I recall being told half a year ago that the Noetherian ring result would be superseded by a more general result on graded rings, which is why I didn't pursue proving it via finSuccEquiv. I can certainly split this part out and provide a proof for the Noetherian ring result.

update: I split this part in #40205
